Where we are

What to include

  • ✦What you're building — a paragraph is plenty to start
  • ✦Platforms — iOS, Android, web, or not sure yet
  • ✦Timing — when you'd like it live, and what's driving that
  • ✦Budget range — even a rough band helps us tell you quickly whether we're a fit

What happens next

We read it properly and reply with either a straight answer or a few questions. If it looks like a fit, we set up a call. If it isn't, we'll say so and point you somewhere better rather than waste your time.

We don't send proposals to people we haven't spoken to, and we don't ask you to sign anything before you know the price.
